sample_type.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/6] The present sample included early adolescents (12 to 15 years), middle adolescents (16 to 18 years), late adolescents (18 to 20 years), and young adults (21 to 23 years). For early and middle adolescents, teachers distributed the questionnaires during class time. For late adolescents, a web page was created, and university students were asked to cooperate. For young adults, data were collected using an online research company (Kanden CS Forum; http://www.kcsf.co.jp/?p=home).
sample_type.warning: The sample includes school-recruited adolescents, university students, and online panel adults, which are all covered by 'community/convenience'.
